correctness.rationale: For C_k obtained by 1->101, 0->000, the one-gap ruler law g_t=3^{v_2(t)} follows from C_(k+1)=C_k 0^{3^k} C_k. Missing two-sided extensions are separated into forbidden zero gaps, interior bispecial ruler blocks 0^{3^r}C_r0^{3^r}, and longest end-context C_(k-1). This yields three top/base words, G-k forbidden 10^t1 gaps, and two per lower level, hence G+k+1. Independently generated literal factor sets and minimal-absence sets and compared EXACTLY with predicted families at k=1..6, obtaining 3,6,13,32,87,250.
residual_risks: Complete all-k classification depends on nontrivial unique-max ruler context and endpoint-exhaustion lemma; finite exact-set experiments alone cannot certify this infinite case split.
